| SCOPE AND SPECIFICATIONS OF THE
PROPOSAL | | | --- | --- | | requirements to procure vendors who provide goods or services purchased by Dallas ISD using federal
dollars. This proposal may be used with local, state, federal, and grant-funded programs. | | | PURPOSE OF REQUEST FOR PROPOSAL (RFP)
This Request for Proposal (RFP) will be for student and staff computing devices, including laptops,
desktops, tablet devices, and display monitors. Vendors participating in this Request for Proposal (RFP) may
submit proposals for one, several, or all categories of devices required by the District. Within each category
of device, the District reserves the right to award contracts to a single vendor or multiple vendors.
The specifications listed in this RFP are the minimum hardware requirements for each tier of device required
by Dallas ISD. Vendors responding to this RFP must have the ability to provide the District with significant
quantities of devices as requested in the pricing lines in this RFP. Note that quantities requested by Dallas
ISD are estimates to be ordered over the five years of the contracts resulting from this RFP. Purchases may
also include a variety of device accessories which will be ordered in a bundle along with the devices. Such
accessories include, but are not limited to, sleeves, cases, mice, keyboards, and cables that may not
necessarily come with the devices.
Each submission must include a detailed plan as to how the vendor will track all shipped products and
provide deployment services. Processes and procedures are required in the response, which outlines how
tracking will be executed and any processes for providing white glove services.
The awarded vendors shall provide Dallas ISD with computing devices that meet all current industry
standard specifications. The awarded vendors and Dallas ISD EdTech-Enterprise Support Services shall
meet every six months or as needed to discuss technology advancements related to computing devices to
be selected by Dallas ISD.
Note: For each purchase during the term of the contracts resulting from this RFP, the District will seek
competitive quotes from one or more of the awarded vendors. | | | PROPOSAL SPECIFICATIONS | | | Manufacturer or Authorized Reseller Qualifications
For proposing vendors who are resellers, a copy of all factory-authorized repair and maintenance
certifications must be submitted with each proposal. Vendors must provide demonstrated competencies and
references in delivering the magnitude of devices listed on the price sheet. This supporting documentation
may include details of past projects, statements in reference letters, and/or project plans.
Equipment Requirements
All equipment must be new and of the manufacturer's current model in production at the time of each order
executed over the life of the contracts resulting from this RFP. All standard or optional equipment must be as
advertised by the original equipment manufacturer (OEM) and must not consist of substitute or aftermarket
equipment. Equipment attachments or parts to be installed must follow the manufacturer's recommendations
or standard industry practices.
Deployment Services
All deliveries and deployments must incorporate white glove services, which include asset decaling, asset
reporting, etching, and delivery to varied locations.
Warranty and Warranty Repair Work
Awarded vendors must be responsible for all materials and accessories used in the equipment, and this
responsibility may not be transferred, conveyed, or assigned to any other entity without previous written
approval of Dallas ISD. | |

| SCOPE AND SPECIFICATIONS OF THE
PROPOSAL | | | --- | --- | | requirements to procure vendors who provide goods or services purchased by Dallas ISD using federal
dollars. This proposal may be used with local, state, federal, and grant-funded programs. | | | PURPOSE OF REQUEST FOR PROPOSAL (RFP)
This Request for Proposal (RFP) will be for student and staff computing devices, including laptops,
desktops, tablet devices, and display monitors. Vendors participating in this Request for Proposal (RFP) may
submit proposals for one, several, or all categories of devices required by the District. Within each category
of device, the District reserves the right to award contracts to a single vendor or multiple vendors.
The specifications listed in this RFP are the minimum hardware requirements for each tier of device required
by Dallas ISD. Vendors responding to this RFP must have the ability to provide the District with significant
quantities of devices as requested in the pricing lines in this RFP. Note that quantities requested by Dallas
ISD are estimates to be ordered over the five years of the contracts resulting from this RFP. Purchases may
also include a variety of device accessories which will be ordered in a bundle along with the devices. Such
accessories include, but are not limited to, sleeves, cases, mice, keyboards, and cables that may not
necessarily come with the devices.
Each submission must include a detailed plan as to how the vendor will track all shipped products and
provide deployment services. Processes and procedures are required in the response, which outlines how
tracking will be executed and any processes for providing white glove services.
The awarded vendors shall provide Dallas ISD with computing devices that meet all current industry
standard specifications. The awarded vendors and Dallas ISD EdTech-Enterprise Support Services shall
meet every six months or as needed to discuss technology advancements related to computing devices to
be selected by Dallas ISD.
Note: For each purchase during the term of the contracts resulting from this RFP, the District will seek
competitive quotes from one or more of the awarded vendors. | | | PROPOSAL SPECIFICATIONS | | | Manufacturer or Authorized Reseller Qualifications
For proposing vendors who are resellers, a copy of all factory-authorized repair and maintenance
certifications must be submitted with each proposal. Vendors must provide demonstrated competencies and
references in delivering the magnitude of devices listed on the price sheet. This supporting documentation
may include details of past projects, statements in reference letters, and/or project plans.
Equipment Requirements
All equipment must be new and of the manufacturer's current model in production at the time of each order
executed over the life of the contracts resulting from this RFP. All standard or optional equipment must be as
advertised by the original equipment manufacturer (OEM) and must not consist of substitute or aftermarket
equipment. Equipment attachments or parts to be installed must follow the manufacturer's recommendations
or standard industry practices.
Deployment Services
All deliveries and deployments must incorporate white glove services, which include asset decaling, asset
reporting, etching, and delivery to varied locations.
Warranty and Warranty Repair Work
Awarded vendors must be responsible for all materials and accessories used in the equipment, and this
responsibility may not be transferred, conveyed, or assigned to any other entity without previous written
approval of Dallas ISD. | |

| PURPOSE OF REQUEST FOR PROPOSAL (RFP)
This Request for Proposal (RFP) will be for student and staff computing devices, including laptops,
desktops, tablet devices, and display monitors. Vendors participating in this Request for Proposal (RFP) may
submit proposals for one, several, or all categories of devices required by the District. Within each category
of device, the District reserves the right to award contracts to a single vendor or multiple vendors.
The specifications listed in this RFP are the minimum hardware requirements for each tier of device required
by Dallas ISD. Vendors responding to this RFP must have the ability to provide the District with significant
quantities of devices as requested in the pricing lines in this RFP. Note that quantities requested by Dallas
ISD are estimates to be ordered over the five years of the contracts resulting from this RFP. Purchases may
also include a variety of device accessories which will be ordered in a bundle along with the devices. Such
accessories include, but are not limited to, sleeves, cases, mice, keyboards, and cables that may not
necessarily come with the devices.
Each submission must include a detailed plan as to how the vendor will track all shipped products and
provide deployment services. Processes and procedures are required in the response, which outlines how

| SCOPE AND SPECIFICATIONS OF THE
PROPOSAL | |

| PURPOSE OF REQUEST FOR PROPOSAL (RFP)
This Request for Proposal (RFP) will be for student and staff computing devices, including laptops,
desktops, tablet devices, and display monitors. Vendors participating in this Request for Proposal (RFP) may
submit proposals for one, several, or all categories of devices required by the District. Within each category
of device, the District reserves the right to award contracts to a single vendor or multiple vendors.
The specifications listed in this RFP are the minimum hardware requirements for each tier of device required
by Dallas ISD. Vendors responding to this RFP must have the ability to provide the District with significant
quantities of devices as requested in the pricing lines in this RFP. Note that quantities requested by Dallas
ISD are estimates to be ordered over the five years of the contracts resulting from this RFP. Purchases may
also include a variety of device accessories which will be ordered in a bundle along with the devices. Such
accessories include, but are not limited to, sleeves, cases, mice, keyboards, and cables that may not
necessarily come with the devices.
Each submission must include a detailed plan as to how the vendor will track all shipped products and
provide deployment services. Processes and procedures are required in the response, which outlines how
tracking will be executed and any processes for providing white glove services.
The awarded vendors shall provide Dallas ISD with computing devices that meet all current industry
standard specifications. The awarded vendors and Dallas ISD EdTech-Enterprise Support Services shall
meet every six months or as needed to discuss technology advancements related to computing devices to
be selected by Dallas ISD.
Note: For each purchase during the term of the contracts resulting from this RFP, the District will seek
competitive quotes from one or more of the awarded vendors. | |
| PROPOSAL SPECIFICATIONS | |

| Manufacturer or Authorized Reseller Qualifications
For proposing vendors who are resellers, a copy of all factory-authorized repair and maintenance
certifications must be submitted with each proposal. Vendors must provide demonstrated competencies and
references in delivering the magnitude of devices listed on the price sheet. This supporting documentation
may include details of past projects, statements in reference letters, and/or project plans.
Equipment Requirements
All equipment must be new and of the manufacturer's current model in production at the time of each order
executed over the life of the contracts resulting from this RFP. All standard or optional equipment must be as
advertised by the original equipment manufacturer (OEM) and must not consist of substitute or aftermarket
equipment. Equipment attachments or parts to be installed must follow the manufacturer's recommendations
or standard industry practices.
Deployment Services
All deliveries and deployments must incorporate white glove services, which include asset decaling, asset
reporting, etching, and delivery to varied locations.
Warranty and Warranty Repair Work
Awarded vendors must be responsible for all materials and accessories used in the equipment, and this
responsibility may not be transferred, conveyed, or assigned to any other entity without previous written
approval of Dallas ISD. | |

| PURPOSE OF REQUEST FOR PROPOSAL (RFP)
This Request for Proposal (RFP) will be for student and staff computing devices, including laptops,
desktops, tablet devices, and display monitors. Vendors participating in this Request for Proposal (RFP) may
submit proposals for one, several, or all categories of devices required by the District. Within each category
of device, the District reserves the right to award contracts to a single vendor or multiple vendors.
The specifications listed in this RFP are the minimum hardware requirements for each tier of device required
by Dallas ISD. Vendors responding to this RFP must have the ability to provide the District with significant
quantities of devices as requested in the pricing lines in this RFP. Note that quantities requested by Dallas
ISD are estimates to be ordered over the five years of the contracts resulting from this RFP. Purchases may
also include a variety of device accessories which will be ordered in a bundle along with the devices. Such
accessories include, but are not limited to, sleeves, cases, mice, keyboards, and cables that may not
necessarily come with the devices.
Each submission must include a detailed plan as to how the vendor will track all shipped products and
provide deployment services. Processes and procedures are required in the response, which outlines how
tracking will be executed and any processes for providing white glove services.
The awarded vendors shall provide Dallas ISD with computing devices that meet all current industry
standard specifications. The awarded vendors and Dallas ISD EdTech-Enterprise Support Services shall
meet every six months or as needed to discuss technology advancements related to computing devices to
be selected by Dallas ISD.
Note: For each purchase during the term of the contracts resulting from this RFP, the District will seek
competitive quotes from one or more of the awarded vendors. | |
| PROPOSAL SPECIFICATIONS | |

| Manufacturer or Authorized Reseller Qualifications
For proposing vendors who are resellers, a copy of all factory-authorized repair and maintenance
certifications must be submitted with each proposal. Vendors must provide demonstrated competencies and
references in delivering the magnitude of devices listed on the price sheet. This supporting documentation
may include details of past projects, statements in reference letters, and/or project plans.
Equipment Requirements
All equipment must be new and of the manufacturer's current model in production at the time of each order
executed over the life of the contracts resulting from this RFP. All standard or optional equipment must be as
advertised by the original equipment manufacturer (OEM) and must not consist of substitute or aftermarket
equipment. Equipment attachments or parts to be installed must follow the manufacturer's recommendations
or standard industry practices.
Deployment Services
All deliveries and deployments must incorporate white glove services, which include asset decaling, asset
reporting, etching, and delivery to varied locations.
Warranty and Warranty Repair Work
Awarded vendors must be responsible for all materials and accessories used in the equipment, and this
responsibility may not be transferred, conveyed, or assigned to any other entity without previous written
approval of Dallas ISD. | |

| PURPOSE OF REQUEST FOR PROPOSAL (RFP)
This Request for Proposal (RFP) will be for student and staff computing devices, including laptops,
desktops, tablet devices, and display monitors. Vendors participating in this Request for Proposal (RFP) may
submit proposals for one, several, or all categories of devices required by the District. Within each category
of device, the District reserves the right to award contracts to a single vendor or multiple vendors.
The specifications listed in this RFP are the minimum hardware requirements for each tier of device required
by Dallas ISD. Vendors responding to this RFP must have the ability to provide the District with significant
quantities of devices as requested in the pricing lines in this RFP. Note that quantities requested by Dallas
ISD are estimates to be ordered over the five years of the contracts resulting from this RFP. Purchases may
also include a variety of device accessories which will be ordered in a bundle along with the devices. Such
accessories include, but are not limited to, sleeves, cases, mice, keyboards, and cables that may not
necessarily come with the devices.
Each submission must include a detailed plan as to how the vendor will track all shipped products and
provide deployment services. Processes and procedures are required in the response, which outlines how
tracking will be executed and any processes for providing white glove services.
The awarded vendors shall provide Dallas ISD with computing devices that meet all current industry
standard specifications. The awarded vendors and Dallas ISD EdTech-Enterprise Support Services shall
meet every six months or as needed to discuss technology advancements related to computing devices to
be selected by Dallas ISD.
Note: For each purchase during the term of the contracts resulting from this RFP, the District will seek
competitive quotes from one or more of the awarded vendors. | |

sources.quote:
| PURPOSE OF REQUEST FOR PROPOSAL (RFP)
This Request for Proposal (RFP) will be for student and staff computing devices, including laptops,
desktops, tablet devices, and display monitors. Vendors participating in this Request for Proposal (RFP) may
submit proposals for one, several, or all categories of devices required by the District. Within each category
of device, the District reserves the right to award contracts to a single vendor or multiple vendors.
The specifications listed in this RFP are the minimum hardware requirements for each tier of device required
by Dallas ISD. Vendors responding to this RFP must have the ability to provide the District with significant
quantities of devices as requested in the pricing lines in this RFP. Note that quantities requested by Dallas
ISD are estimates to be ordered over the five years of the contracts resulting from this RFP. Purchases may
also include a variety of device accessories which will be ordered in a bundle along with the devices. Such
accessories include, but are not limited to, sleeves, cases, mice, keyboards, and cables that may not
necessarily come with the devices.
Each submission must include a detailed plan as to how the vendor will track all shipped products and
provide deployment services. Processes and procedures are required in the response, which outlines how
tracking will be executed and any processes for providing white glove services.
The awarded vendors shall provide Dallas ISD with computing devices that meet all current industry
standard specifications. The awarded vendors and Dallas ISD EdTech-Enterprise Support Services shall
meet every six months or as needed to discuss technology advancements related to computing devices to
be selected by Dallas ISD.
Note: For each purchase during the term of the contracts resulting from this RFP, the District will seek
competitive quotes from one or more of the awarded vendors. | |

Wilmer, Hutchins and parts of Carrollton, DeSoto, Duncanville, Farmers Branch, Garland, Highland Park,
Lancaster, Mesquite, Balch Springs, and Combine. The district is the second-largest public school district in
the state and the 16th-largest in the nation. We are proud of our award-winning schools, outstanding
teachers and staff, committed parents and volunteers who comprise the dedicated team that serves
approximately 141,000 students in prekindergarten through 12th grade, in 240 schools, served by more than

sources.quote:
| PURPOSE OF REQUEST FOR PROPOSAL (RFP)
This Request for Proposal (RFP) will be for student and staff computing devices, including laptops,
desktops, tablet devices, and display monitors. Vendors participating in this Request for Proposal (RFP) may
submit proposals for one, several, or all categories of devices required by the District. Within each category
of device, the District reserves the right to award contracts to a single vendor or multiple vendors.
The specifications listed in this RFP are the minimum hardware requirements for each tier of device required
by Dallas ISD. Vendors responding to this RFP must have the ability to provide the District with significant
quantities of devices as requested in the pricing lines in this RFP. Note that quantities requested by Dallas
ISD are estimates to be ordered over the five years of the contracts resulting from this RFP. Purchases may
also include a variety of device accessories which will be ordered in a bundle along with the devices. Such
accessories include, but are not limited to, sleeves, cases, mice, keyboards, and cables that may not
necessarily come with the devices.
Each submission must include a detailed plan as to how the vendor will track all shipped products and
provide deployment services. Processes and procedures are required in the response, which outlines how
tracking will be executed and any processes for providing white glove services.
The awarded vendors shall provide Dallas ISD with computing devices that meet all current industry
standard specifications. The awarded vendors and Dallas ISD EdTech-Enterprise Support Services shall
meet every six months or as needed to discuss technology advancements related to computing devices to
be selected by Dallas ISD.
Note: For each purchase during the term of the contracts resulting from this RFP, the District will seek
competitive quotes from one or more of the awarded vendors. | |

| PURPOSE OF REQUEST FOR PROPOSAL (RFP)
This Request for Proposal (RFP) will be for student and staff computing devices, including laptops,
desktops, tablet devices, and display monitors. Vendors participating in this Request for Proposal (RFP) may
submit proposals for one, several, or all categories of devices required by the District. Within each category
of device, the District reserves the right to award contracts to a single vendor or multiple vendors.
The specifications listed in this RFP are the minimum hardware requirements for each tier of device required
by Dallas ISD. Vendors responding to this RFP must have the ability to provide the District with significant
quantities of devices as requested in the pricing lines in this RFP. Note that quantities requested by Dallas
ISD are estimates to be ordered over the five years of the contracts resulting from this RFP. Purchases may
also include a variety of device accessories which will be ordered in a bundle along with the devices. Such
accessories include, but are not limited to, sleeves, cases, mice, keyboards, and cables that may not
necessarily come with the devices.

provide deployment services. Processes and procedures are required in the response, which outlines how

standard specifications. The awarded vendors and Dallas ISD EdTech-Enterprise Support Services shall
meet every six months or as needed to discuss technology advancements related to computing devices to
be selected by Dallas ISD.

sources.quote:
| PURPOSE OF REQUEST FOR PROPOSAL (RFP)
This Request for Proposal (RFP) will be for student and staff computing devices, including laptops,
desktops, tablet devices, and display monitors. Vendors participating in this Request for Proposal (RFP) may
submit proposals for one, several, or all categories of devices required by the District. Within each category
of device, the District reserves the right to award contracts to a single vendor or multiple vendors.
The specifications listed in this RFP are the minimum hardware requirements for each tier of device required
by Dallas ISD. Vendors responding to this RFP must have the ability to provide the District with significant
quantities of devices as requested in the pricing lines in this RFP. Note that quantities requested by Dallas
ISD are estimates to be ordered over the five years of the contracts resulting from this RFP. Purchases may
also include a variety of device accessories which will be ordered in a bundle along with the devices. Such
accessories include, but are not limited to, sleeves, cases, mice, keyboards, and cables that may not
necessarily come with the devices.
Each submission must include a detailed plan as to how the vendor will track all shipped products and
provide deployment services. Processes and procedures are required in the response, which outlines how
tracking will be executed and any processes for providing white glove services.
The awarded vendors shall provide Dallas ISD with computing devices that meet all current industry
standard specifications. The awarded vendors and Dallas ISD EdTech-Enterprise Support Services shall
meet every six months or as needed to discuss technology advancements related to computing devices to
be selected by Dallas ISD.
Note: For each purchase during the term of the contracts resulting from this RFP, the District will seek
competitive quotes from one or more of the awarded vendors. | |

field_notes.Installation: Explicit vendor setup/deployment/imaging/tagging/installation requirements. Also report literal requirements that equipment arrive assembled, serviced, adjusted or demonstrated, clearly labeled as those requirements; do not invent onsite deployment or imaging. A standard preinstalled OS by itself is a product specification, not a separate vendor installation service.
field_notes.Bid Submission Type: Accepted and prohibited submission methods, packaging, original/copy requirements, and submission location where stated. Multiple cited instructions can jointly describe the submission method.
field_notes.Due Date: Final submission deadline, including time and source time zone when explicitly stated. Compare all retrieved clauses for the same deadline and include the explicit zone from the most complete clause; do not claim no source zone merely because another duplicate clause omits it. When no zone is stated, retain the date/time, label the zone unknown, and never infer it from a location; do not confuse with questions deadlines. Preserve literal zone abbreviations; disclose conflicting sources instead of silently correcting them.
field_notes.Pre Bid Meeting: Date, time, location/online method and mandatory status when explicit. Do not assume mandatory or optional if unstated.
field_notes.Bid Bond Requirement: Bid bond, not insurance limits, performance bond, or funding from municipal bonds. Use Not required only when explicitly stated.
field_notes.Model_no: Exact manufacturer commercial model designations. When a table labels an opaque code as Model but supplies the readable commercial device name in its Details/Description column, include that commercial designation; the table code can be included separately with its label. Do not return only that code while omitting the stated commercial name. Product categories, tier labels, processor names and generic device types are not commercial models. If only categories or tiers are supplied, return null. A system integration/configuration reference (SI or quote ID) alone is not the product model; put it in Part_no.
field_notes.Part_no: Manufacturer part/order/configuration identifiers with their roles. A brand, commercial model designation or device-model suffix is not a separate part number. Case compatibility model names are not case SKUs. If only commercial model/compatibility designations are supplied, return null. A separately tabulated opaque order/configuration code with a distinct commercial product description may be reported as a source product code (preserve its source label); do not claim a model suffix is a separately supplied SKU. Include primary product/base SKU and configured-system references when supplied; exclude CPU model names and procurement identifiers.
field_notes.Contract or Cooperative to use: Referenced master/state/cooperative contract name and identifier, including contract eligibility restrictions. A master contract under which this purchase is competed belongs here even if the word cooperative is absent. If the evidence only names a cooperative, report it as referenced rather than asserting mandatory use. A cited cooperative name is enough to report a reference, but not enough to infer eligibility or obligation.
field_notes.MFG for Registration: Name the manufacturer(s) the bidder must be registered or authorized with. An OEM warranty obligation is not bidder registration. A named equipment brand and a separate requirement for authorization from that equipment manufacturer may be combined using citations to both clauses; distinguish distributor authorization from direct manufacturer registration. A brand alone does not prove an authorization requirement. Generic certifications without a named manufacturer do not identify one; use null when no manufacturer registration/authorization requirement is stated.
field_notes.contact_info: Procurement/solicitation contact name, email and phone when stated. A delivery coordination department or technical support team is not a replacement procurement contact.
field_notes.company_name: Issuing organization, not the supplier or manufacturer.
field_notes.Product: Products and quantities; include stated quantities in the value, not only the notes. Distinguish estimated volume from guaranteed orders. A unit-price example is not an order quantity: label unit pricing as such and state that a total quantity is unspecified/not guaranteed where applicable.
field_notes.Product Specification: Retain all explicitly listed technical attributes for each category: CPU/clock, memory, storage, display, OS, graphics, connectivity, ports, power/battery, input/camera/audio, carry case/accessories, licensing and warranty/service conditions when stated. Condense repeated wording without dropping attribute values, units, category mappings or qualifiers. Do not replace actual accessory/warranty details with proposal-description headings. Do not invent unstated attributes.
field_notes.Delivery Date: Delivery deadline/window, not a planned quote request or anticipated award date.
field_notes.Any Additional Documentation Required: All expressly required submission/supporting documents and post-award/on-request forms, including conditional certificates, insurance proof/policy copies, affidavits and disclosures. Preserve each timing/condition without assuming it applies; do not turn a conditional form or attachment into an unconditional obligation.

|Col1|Questions Due (Closing) Date and Time:
06/01/2024 at 2:00 PM EDT
Questions must be submitted in writing to
thawkins@treasurer.state.md.us with the subject line,
“QUESTION for Dell Laptop #E20P4600040”, and be
submitted in writing via e-mail to the Procurement Officer no later
than the date and time specified.| |---|---| |**Security Requirements (if**
**applicable):**
|
1. The Department reserves the right to purchase more or less
than the specified quantity to the extent limited by funding.

2. The Master Contractor must provide the estimated ship
date/lead time for each item listed in the PORFP FA I

3. Please allow proposals/quotes provided in response to this
PORFP to be valid for at least 90 days after the set due date
above.

4. The Master Contractor must be an authorized reseller for Dell.
The state reserves the right to request a Letter of Authorization
(LOA) from the Manufacturer or Distributor.

5. Purchase new and unused equipment.

6. The Master Contractor shall not impose a restocking fee if an
item is returned due to damage or incorrect product shipped.

7. ENERGY STAR certified product

8. The Master Contractor must provide a Mercury Affidavit:
https://doit.maryland.gov/contracts/Documents/hardware_co
ntract/hwmercury_affidavit.pdf

9. Delivery within**45** days of Award.

| |**Invoicing Instructions:**
|
1. Email invoices to:
STOaccountspayable@treasurer.state.md.us

2. Invoice(s) shall be submitted within 10 days of delivering the
equipment and shall include at a minimum the following:
• Contractor name, mailing address, social security number
or Federal Tax ID number, and phone number.
• Reference the States assigned PORFP number.
• Date, invoice number and amount due.

3. Proof of delivery including packing slip or delivery
confirmation, and equipment serial numbers.

|Col1|Questions Due (Closing) Date and Time:
06/01/2024 at 2:00 PM EDT
Questions must be submitted in writing to
thawkins@treasurer.state.md.us with the subject line,
“QUESTION for Dell Laptop #E20P4600040”, and be
submitted in writing via e-mail to the Procurement Officer no later
than the date and time specified.| |---|---| |**Security Requirements (if**
**applicable):**
|
1. The Department reserves the right to purchase more or less
than the specified quantity to the extent limited by funding.

2. The Master Contractor must provide the estimated ship
date/lead time for each item listed in the PORFP FA I

3. Please allow proposals/quotes provided in response to this
PORFP to be valid for at least 90 days after the set due date
above.

4. The Master Contractor must be an authorized reseller for Dell.
The state reserves the right to request a Letter of Authorization
(LOA) from the Manufacturer or Distributor.

5. Purchase new and unused equipment.

6. The Master Contractor shall not impose a restocking fee if an
item is returned due to damage or incorrect product shipped.

7. ENERGY STAR certified product

8. The Master Contractor must provide a Mercury Affidavit:
https://doit.maryland.gov/contracts/Documents/hardware_co
ntract/hwmercury_affidavit.pdf

9. Delivery within**45** days of Award.

| |**Invoicing Instructions:**
|
1. Email invoices to:
STOaccountspayable@treasurer.state.md.us

2. Invoice(s) shall be submitted within 10 days of delivering the
equipment and shall include at a minimum the following:
• Contractor name, mailing address, social security number
or Federal Tax ID number, and phone number.
• Reference the States assigned PORFP number.
• Date, invoice number and amount due.

3. Proof of delivery including packing slip or delivery
confirmation, and equipment serial numbers.
